text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Classic races, the 
Satsuki Sho— The one who claimed victory 
was neither Narita Top Road nor Admire 
Vega, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O! The one who stole the 
spotlight from the two leading stars was 
the girl everyone had written off as 
merely a clown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the King shall crush all who 
oppose— True to those words, her run was 
brimming with spirit, instantly thrusting 
her to the forefront of the Classic 
circuit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the Japanese Derby (Tokyo 
Yushun). Against her idolized star and the 
unveiled Supreme Overlord, Narita Top Road 
steps up to challenge them once again!
